canonical_multiple.name: Multiple canonicals
canonical_multiple.desc: The page has more than one rel=canonical; search engines may ignore all of them.

canonical_invalid.name: Invalid canonical
canonical_invalid.desc: The canonical value is empty or does not resolve to a valid http(s) URL.
canonical_invalid.fix: Set the canonical to the absolute URL of the preferred page.

canonical_in_body.name: Canonical inside <body>
canonical_in_body.desc: rel=canonical appears outside <head>; search engines may ignore it.

canonical_protocol_mismatch.name: Canonical HTTP/HTTPS mismatch
canonical_protocol_mismatch.desc: The canonical points to a different protocol than the page uses (e.g. from HTTPS to HTTP).
canonical_protocol_mismatch.fix: Use the site's preferred protocol (usually HTTPS) in the canonical.

canonical_external.name: Canonical points to another domain
canonical_external.desc: The canonical points to a domain outside the crawl scope. Unless this is intentional syndication, the page may drop out of the index.
canonical_external.fix: If unintentional, point the canonical to the page itself or the preferred version on this site.

canonical_relative.name: Relative canonical
canonical_relative.desc: The canonical uses a relative address. Valid, but an absolute URL is recommended.
canonical_relative.fix: Write the canonical as an absolute URL (https://...).

canonical_noindex_conflict.name: Noindex and canonical conflict
canonical_noindex_conflict.desc: The page has both noindex and a canonical to another URL; these are mixed signals.
canonical_noindex_conflict.fix: Pick one signal: canonical only if it duplicates another page, noindex only if it should not be indexed.

canonical_changed_by_js.name: Canonical changed by JavaScript
canonical_changed_by_js.desc: The canonical in the raw HTML differs from the one in the rendered DOM.
canonical_changed_by_js.fix: Serve the correct canonical server-side in the raw HTML.

canonical_target_error.name: Canonical target returns an error
canonical_target_error.desc: The canonical URL returns 4xx/5xx or cannot be reached.
canonical_target_error.fix: Point the canonical to an indexable URL returning 200.

canonical_target_redirect.name: Canonical target redirects
canonical_target_redirect.desc: The canonical URL redirects to another address.
canonical_target_redirect.fix: Point the canonical directly to the final URL.

canonical_target_noindex.name: Canonical target is noindex
canonical_target_noindex.desc: The canonical target has noindex; the signals contradict each other.
canonical_target_noindex.fix: Remove noindex from the target or point the canonical to an indexable page.

canonical_target_canonicalised.name: Canonical chain
canonical_target_canonicalised.desc: The canonical target itself canonicalises to another URL.
canonical_target_canonicalised.fix: Make every page's canonical point directly to the final preferred URL.

canonical_missing_on_variant.name: No canonical on a page with variations
canonical_missing_on_variant.desc: An indexable page with parameters or URL variations has no canonical. (A missing canonical alone is not an error; it is reported here because of duplication risk.)
canonical_missing_on_variant.fix: Add a self-referencing canonical pointing to the preferred URL.

noindex.name: Noindex
noindex.desc: The page has noindex via meta robots or X-Robots-Tag and is technically not indexable. On an important page (in the sitemap, heavily linked or the home page) this is probably unintended.
noindex.fix: Remove noindex if the page should be indexed; otherwise remove it from the sitemap.

nofollow_page.name: Page-level nofollow
nofollow_page.desc: The page has nofollow via meta robots/X-Robots-Tag; its links will not be followed.
nofollow_page.fix: Remove the nofollow directive if the links should be followed.

blocked_by_robots.name: Blocked by robots.txt
blocked_by_robots.desc: The URL was not crawled because of robots.txt rules. Blocked URLs can still be indexed without content through links.
blocked_by_robots.fix: Update robots.txt if it should be crawled; to keep it out of the index allow crawling and use noindex.

robots_changed_by_js.name: Robots directive changed by JavaScript
robots_changed_by_js.desc: noindex/nofollow differs between the raw HTML and the rendered DOM; search engines may decide based on the raw signal.
robots_changed_by_js.fix: Serve the final robots meta tag server-side in the raw HTML.

image_missing_alt.name: Image without alt attribute
image_missing_alt.desc: Images have no alt attribute at all. (An empty alt="" is valid for decorative images and is not reported here.)
image_missing_alt.fix: Add descriptive alt text to meaningful images; use alt="" for decorative ones.

image_link_missing_alt.name: Linked image without alt
image_link_missing_alt.desc: Links whose only content is an image have no alt text, leaving the link text (anchor) empty.
image_link_missing_alt.fix: Give the image inside the link an alt text describing the link target.

image_missing_dimensions.name: Image dimensions not set
image_missing_dimensions.desc: Images have no width/height attributes, which can cause layout shifts while loading.
image_missing_dimensions.fix: Add width and height (or a CSS aspect-ratio) to images.

image_no_lazy_loading.name: Lazy loading not used
image_no_lazy_loading.desc: A page with many images uses loading="lazy" on none of them.
image_no_lazy_loading.fix: Add loading="lazy" to below-the-fold images (not to images in the first viewport).

image_broken.name: Broken image
image_broken.desc: An image used on the page returns 4xx/5xx or cannot be reached.
image_broken.fix: Fix the image path or re-upload the image.

image_too_large.name: Large image file
image_too_large.desc: The image file exceeds the configured size threshold and can slow down page loading.
image_too_large.fix: Compress and resize the image; consider modern formats such as WebP/AVIF.

image_legacy_format.name: Legacy image format
image_legacy_format.desc: The image uses a web-inefficient format such as BMP/TIFF/ICO.
image_legacy_format.fix: Convert the image to WebP, AVIF, JPEG or PNG.

image_duplicate_variants.name: Same image under different URLs
image_duplicate_variants.desc: The same image file is loaded from several URLs differing only by query string or case, reducing cache efficiency.
image_duplicate_variants.fix: Reference the image with one consistent URL everywhere.

no_internal_outlinks.name: No internal links
no_internal_outlinks.desc: The page links to no other internal page (dead end).
no_internal_outlinks.fix: Add contextual internal links to related pages.

too_many_links.name: Too many links
too_many_links.desc: The page has a very large number of links, diluting link value and possibly confusing users.
too_many_links.fix: Reduce unnecessary links and simplify navigation.

internal_nofollow.name: Nofollow internal link
internal_nofollow.desc: The page links to internal URLs with rel=nofollow; those pages may not be discovered.
internal_nofollow.fix: Do not use nofollow on internal links; manage pages that should not be crawled with robots.txt or noindex.

empty_anchor.name: Empty anchor text
empty_anchor.desc: Internal links have no visible text (anchor), so their target is unclear.
empty_anchor.fix: Add text or an aria-label describing the target page.

deep_page.name: Deep page
deep_page.desc: Reaching this indexable page from the start page takes more clicks than the threshold.
deep_page.fix: Provide shorter paths to important pages via main menus, categories or contextual links.

orphan_candidate.name: Orphan page candidate
orphan_candidate.desc: The URL is in the sitemap but receives no links from any crawled page. This is not definitive: the link may be on a page that was not crawled.
orphan_candidate.fix: If the page matters, link to it from related pages; if not, remove it from the sitemap.

thin_content.name: Thin content
thin_content.desc: Visible text is below the configured word threshold. The threshold is a suggested value.
thin_content.fix: Add valuable, original content or merge similar pages.

duplicate_content.name: Exact duplicate content
duplicate_content.desc: Several indexable pages have identical visible text.
duplicate_content.fix: Prefer one version; 301-redirect the others or use canonicals.

near_duplicate_candidate.name: Near-duplicate candidate
near_duplicate_candidate.desc: The page text is very similar to other pages (estimated with SimHash). Not definitive; template-heavy pages can match too.
near_duplicate_candidate.fix: Review the pages; merge, differentiate or canonicalise genuine duplicates.

content_depends_on_js.name: Content depends on JavaScript
content_depends_on_js.desc: The rendered page contains noticeably more text than the raw HTML.

title_changed_by_js.name: Title changed by JavaScript
title_changed_by_js.desc: The title in the raw HTML differs from the rendered title.
title_changed_by_js.fix: Serve the final title server-side in the raw HTML.

links_only_in_rendered_dom.name: Links only in the rendered DOM
links_only_in_rendered_dom.desc: Some links appear only after JavaScript runs; crawlers that do not render cannot discover them.
links_only_in_rendered_dom.fix: Serve important navigation links as <a href> in the raw HTML.

render_failed.name: Rendering failed
render_failed.desc: The page could not be rendered in the browser (timeout or page error); it was analysed from raw HTML.
render_failed.fix: Make sure the page loads without errors in a browser; raise the render timeout if needed.

structured_data_syntax_error.name: JSON-LD syntax error
structured_data_syntax_error.desc: A JSON-LD block is not valid JSON and cannot be read by search engines.
structured_data_syntax_error.fix: Validate the JSON and fix the syntax error.

structured_data_invalid.name: Incomplete structured data declaration
structured_data_invalid.desc: Structured data is missing the schema.org context or type (@context/@type, itemtype).

structured_data_missing_fields.name: Basic structured data fields missing
structured_data_missing_fields.desc: Some basic fields for the schema.org type are missing. This check covers basic fields only and does not validate all of Google's rich result rules.
structured_data_missing_fields.fix: Add the missing fields and also validate with Google's Rich Results Test.

og_missing.name: Open Graph tags missing
og_missing.desc: Some of og:title, og:description, og:image or og:url are missing; social shares may not look as intended.
og_missing.fix: Add the missing Open Graph tags.

og_image_not_absolute.name: og:image is not absolute
og_image_not_absolute.desc: og:image is a relative address; many platforms accept absolute URLs only.
og_image_not_absolute.fix: Make og:image an absolute URL starting with https://.

og_url_mismatch.name: og:url differs from canonical
og_url_mismatch.desc: og:url differs from the page's canonical URL.
og_url_mismatch.fix: Make og:url the same as the canonical URL.

twitter_card_missing.name: Twitter/X Card tag missing
twitter_card_missing.desc: There is no twitter:card tag; X partly falls back to Open Graph.

html_lang_missing.name: HTML lang attribute missing
html_lang_missing.desc: The <html> tag has no lang attribute; recommended for accessibility and language detection.
html_lang_missing.fix: Add the correct language code, e.g. <html lang="en">.

hreflang_invalid_code.name: Invalid hreflang code
hreflang_invalid_code.desc: The hreflang value does not follow the language[-region] format or contains a common mistake (e.g. en-uk instead of en-gb).
hreflang_invalid_code.fix: Use an ISO 639-1 language code and optional ISO 3166-1 region code (e.g. tr-TR, en-GB, x-default).

hreflang_missing_self.name: hreflang without self-reference
hreflang_missing_self.desc: The hreflang set does not include the page's own URL.
hreflang_missing_self.fix: Add an entry pointing to the page itself in its hreflang set.

hreflang_not_absolute.name: hreflang URL not absolute
hreflang_not_absolute.desc: The hreflang href is relative; absolute URLs are required.
hreflang_not_absolute.fix: Write hreflang href values as full URLs.

hreflang_duplicate_lang.name: Several hreflang for one language
hreflang_duplicate_lang.desc: The same hreflang code points to different URLs.
hreflang_duplicate_lang.fix: Use a single URL per language-region code.

hreflang_target_error.name: hreflang target error
hreflang_target_error.desc: The hreflang target does not return 200 (redirect, 4xx/5xx or unreachable).
hreflang_target_error.fix: Point hreflang directly to the final URL returning 200.

hreflang_no_return.name: Missing hreflang return link
hreflang_no_return.desc: The target page does not link back to this page with hreflang; non-reciprocal hreflang may be ignored.
hreflang_no_return.fix: Add an hreflang entry pointing back to this page on the target page.

hreflang_target_non_canonical.name: hreflang target not indexable
hreflang_target_non_canonical.desc: The hreflang target has noindex or canonicalises to another URL.
hreflang_target_non_canonical.fix: Use hreflang only for indexable, self-canonical URLs.

robots_unavailable.name: robots.txt unavailable
robots_unavailable.desc: robots.txt returned 5xx/429 or could not be reached. Search engines may then temporarily not crawl the site at all; Zerqon Spider also stayed cautious and did not crawl.
robots_unavailable.fix: Make sure robots.txt returns 200 (or 404 if it does not exist).

robots_missing.name: robots.txt not found
robots_missing.desc: robots.txt returned 4xx; all URLs are considered crawlable. This is not an error.
robots_missing.fix: Consider adding a robots.txt for crawl rules and a Sitemap declaration.

sitemap_missing.name: No XML sitemap found
sitemap_missing.desc: robots.txt declares no Sitemap and /sitemap.xml is not available.
sitemap_missing.fix: Create an XML sitemap and add a Sitemap: line to robots.txt.

sitemap_invalid.name: Invalid XML sitemap
sitemap_invalid.desc: The sitemap could not be parsed as XML or is not a urlset/sitemapindex.
sitemap_invalid.fix: Fix the sitemap according to the sitemaps.org protocol and validate the XML.

sitemap_error.name: Sitemap could not be fetched
sitemap_error.desc: A declared sitemap returned a non-200 response or could not be reached.
sitemap_error.fix: Check that the sitemap URL is correct and returns 200.

sitemap_not_in_robots.name: Sitemap not declared in robots.txt
sitemap_not_in_robots.desc: A sitemap was found at the default location, but robots.txt has no Sitemap: line.
sitemap_not_in_robots.fix: Add a Sitemap: <url> line to robots.txt.

sitemap_url_non_200.name: Non-200 URL in sitemap
sitemap_url_non_200.desc: The sitemap contains a URL that redirects or errors. Sitemaps should list only final, indexable URLs.
sitemap_url_non_200.fix: Remove the URL from the sitemap or replace it with the final URL.

sitemap_url_noindex.name: Noindex URL in sitemap
sitemap_url_noindex.desc: A URL listed in the sitemap has noindex; a contradictory signal.
sitemap_url_noindex.fix: Remove noindex if it should be indexed; otherwise remove it from the sitemap.

sitemap_url_non_canonical.name: Non-canonical URL in sitemap
sitemap_url_non_canonical.desc: A URL in the sitemap canonicalises to another page.
sitemap_url_non_canonical.fix: List only canonical (preferred) URLs in the sitemap.

sitemap_url_blocked.name: Sitemap URL blocked by robots.txt
sitemap_url_blocked.desc: A URL in the sitemap is disallowed by robots.txt.
sitemap_url_blocked.fix: Make robots rules and the sitemap consistent.

viewport_missing.name: Viewport meta tag missing
viewport_missing.desc: The page has no viewport meta tag and may not display properly on mobile devices.
